disposition_policy.semgrep_findings_next_action: Review the 335 exact-source Semgrep findings, prioritizing the two runtime process-launch candidates; keep all unresolved items open.

scope.explanation: All 54 Semgrep errors are classified; 4 are internal rule execution errors and 50 are documented parser coverage gaps. Supplemental CI scanners and a syntax parser check are retained, but the TypeScript parse check is not security coverage and the Semgrep runtime coverage gate remains incomplete.
scope.note: Counts are scanner records, not unique vulnerabilities. Cross-scanner location overlaps are reported separately; no aggregate unique-vulnerability claim is made.
